name: Auntie
text: Ivo Reed signed out the brass hero clock for The midnight picnic. The clapper is removed.

name: Wicker basket
text: Ivo Reed moved the basket from the cut orchard scene to The midnight picnic.

name: picnic clock
text: Tessa Moss returned the picnic clock, also called Auntie, to Ivo Reed. Both names mean P-01.

name: Rehearsal desk bell
text: Ivo Reed tested the working bell for The clockmaker opens shop. P-02 is separate from P-01. It is ready for 28 November and stays off stage.

name: Wicker basket
text: Tessa Moss received the basket with two stitched cloth sandwiches. It is ready for the 28 November rehearsal.
